title: Write a known item
summary: PutItem writes a complete item at its key.
introduction: PutItem writes a complete item at its key. Your task: Add a second item with book set to garden-days.
learningObjectives: Add a second item with book set to garden-days.
Explain the example for write a known item

blocks.text: PutItem writes a complete item at its key. A later PutItem with the same key replaces the item unless a condition prevents it.

Use DynamoDB Local and the AWS CLI or SDK in a separate practice project. Point every command at http://localhost:8000. Low-level JSON examples show request bodies; provide them to the matching CLI command or SDK method.
Read the code step by step

items: Item contains the complete low-level value map to store at the key.
Because PutItem replaces an existing item, use a condition or partial update when replacement is not intended.

blocks.text: Send this to the local put-item operation. The item is stored at Mia's moon-trip key.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: PutItem is a replacement operation. Use UpdateItem when only selected attributes should change.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Add a second item with book set to garden-days.
